test_type: isolated Node full-season simulation using the production simulateMatch function with test-only simplified lineup/player stubs
limitations: Synthetic team strengths and near-uniform player attributes; not the full browser app or actual embedded club squads.

change: Goal conversion multiplier in regular simulateMatch increased from 1.95 to 2.2 after season batches showed 2.38–2.51 goals per match; this targets a more plausible overall scoring rate while checking that league strength still predicts table position.
